Introduction

Baby DONT Cry is a four-member South Korean girl group under P Nation.

On February 6, 2025, it was announced that P Nation was preparing to debut its first-ever girl group sometime later that year. Also, it was revealed that i-dle member Soyeon would be in charge of the group's creative direction and music.

On April 11, 2025, P Nation's founder and veteran singer PSY released a performance video of four female trainees that were being considered as the debuting lineup for the girl group, then known as "P Girls".

On June 19, 2025, P Nation revealed the group's debuting name, Baby DONT Cry, and their debut date: June 23, 2025.

Baby DONT Cry announced members one by one from June 10 to June 13, 2025, starting with Yihyun on June 10, followed by Kumi on June 11, Mia on June 12, and finally Beni on June 13.
